data.title: Electricity price increase from 1 January 2026
data.summary: Beispiel Energie AG announces higher electricity prices from 1 January 2026. The monthly advance payment (Abschlag) rises from €72.00 to €81.00.
data.explanation: Your electricity provider is raising its prices because of higher grid fees and procurement costs. The unit price and base fee both go up, so your monthly advance payment rises from €72.00 to €81.00. You have a special right to cancel (Sonderkündigungsrecht) without a notice period, effective when the change takes effect. The cancellation must be in text form (for example an e-mail). You may decide whether to stay or switch provider; the app shows until when you can cancel. If you do nothing, the new prices apply.
